problems.problem: Collecting plain-text administrative passwords on a general web onboarding form may create credential-handling overhead and security exposure compared to a dedicated vault or PSA onboarding workflow.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The onboarding page asks new clients to type server, local admin, and network passwords directly into form fields.

problems.problem: The homepage counter showing 'Tickets Resolved Last Month 0' appears to be an unmaintained or broken website counter widget.
problems.label: inference
problems.basis: Observed directly on https://www.tvit.net/ where the counter value reads 0.

existingSolutions.solution: Existing IT client portal and PSA/documentation stack (tvit.itclientportal.com) and Microsoft 365 toolset
existingSolutions.addresses: Structured client onboarding, credential documentation, and ticket management

feasibility.explanation: Treasure Valley IT is a Managed IT Service Provider outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical), so no ForgeX solution is recommended.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is outside ForgeX's target market and operates as an IT services provider.

humanReview: No ForgeX automation is recommended; if the founder reviews this account, no outreach should be sent.

risks.description: Requesting server, computer, and network administrator passwords via a web form on https://www.tvit.net/client-support/client-onboarding-form/ carries credential-storage and transmission risks if not routed directly into an encrypted password manager.
Pursuing an IT managed service provider falls outside ForgeX's home-service contractor specialization and standardized field-service integrations.

assumptions: The website does not publish service pricing, and the company is not a fit for ForgeX's catalog.

limitations: https://www.tvit.net/contact-us/ refused automated access (HTTP 403) and could not be read.
The Meet Our Team and About pages do not name any owners, executives, or managers.
Employee headcount, revenue, and service pricing are not published on the pages read.
State business-registration details are not published on the website.

qualification.rationale: Treasure Valley IT is a Managed IT Service Provider (MSP) offering IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and software support services rather than an owner-led home-service contractor in HVAC, plumbing, or electrical. Additionally, as an IT services provider with its own technical staff and client portal systems, it falls outside ForgeX's target segment.
